nodes.name: 1. List All Specs
nodes.notes: Scans the specs/ folder and emits one item per JSON spec file.

nodes.name: 2. Skip Already Rendered
nodes.notes: Only passes through specs whose output MP4 doesn't exist yet.

nodes.name: 3. Render Short
nodes.notes: Runs spark_shorts.py make for each spec.

nodes.name: 4. Summary
nodes.notes: Reports how many shorts are now in the out/ folder.
